data.title: Matrix Reflection and Index Permutation
data.description: Practice the foundational algebraic transformation of swapping rows and columns across a series of non-square matrices. Observe how dimensions invert and structural symmetry is revealed through systematic transposition.

challenges.instruction: Transpose the 2×3 matrix. Enter each entry of the resulting 3×2 matrix.
challenges.hint: Row i of A becomes column i of Aᵀ. The transpose of a 2×3 matrix is a 3×2 matrix.

data.educationalContext: Transposition is a fundamental algebraic operation with profound implications in linear transformations, solving systems of linear equations, and computing covariance matrices in multivariate statistics. By inverting the row and column indices of a matrix, mathematicians can analyze dual spaces and orthogonal complements.
